o.text: From Proto-Turkic *kȫpek. Cognate with Turkish göbek, Chuvash кӑвапа (kăvap̬a), etc.
From Persian زندانبان. By surface analysis, zindan + -ban.
Probably a back-formation from оксита́нский, from Latin Occitānus.
